item.title: Anatomy Of 4 Things I Made (With the Help Of My Buddy Claude)
item.description:
Oct 6, 2026: GÖTEBORG

A look at my struggles to wrangle Claude Code to do my bidding & whether or not training & domain expertise are still valid in the AI era (which is upon us whether we like it or not.)

Additionally, some (hopefully) helpful tips on how to navigate creating, working, careers in technology & the Claude folder structure / auto-memory system.
